subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's route-accurate loopback proof as sufficient after refresh, or require a live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload capture before closing this issue?
rationale: The source-level failure is clear, but the remaining merge path turns on maintainer acceptance of proof scope and conflict/CI cleanup for the open linked PR.

options.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof After Refresh
options.body: Refresh the linked PR, clear or explain its checks, and accept its production transport loopback proof if maintainers agree live OpenRouter credentials are not required.

options.title: Require Live Provider Proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR paused until someone supplies a redacted live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 payload capture for plain-text and tool-call replay turns.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Maintainer Patch
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting PR only after a maintainer-owned patch lands with equivalent sanitizer, transcript-policy, and regression-test coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof After Refresh
